payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_task.py::test_ready_task_refuses_an_orphaned_task_whose_cell_recorded_no_review_turn stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/task.py. The claim was '`ready_task` refuses an `ORPHANED` task whose cell recorded no `REVIEWING` turn, and the reason names the task id, `ORPHANED` and `REVIEWING`. "This cell" is every turn at or after the cutoff `ready_task` already reads from `baseline.json`. The witness drives two such tasks. One has passing gate results on two suite turns of this cell and no `REVIEWING` turn. The other has a `REVIEWING` turn only before the cutoff. The same task with a `REVIEWING` turn after the cutoff is admitted.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_task.py::test_ready_task_rebuilds_every_field_package_reads_from_the_cells_record, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
